info.name: Procurement Portal API
info.description:
Walks the procurement workflow: submit, validation, approve, order, deliver, rejection, the monthly budget and security.
Start the backend first (http://localhost:8119). Repeatable: it registers a fresh employee and uses tiny amounts.

item.name: Register a fresh employee for this run

exec: pm.test("Pending, with the total worked out", () => { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("PENDING"); pm.expect(r.estimatedTotal).to.eql(100); });

item.name: Another employee does not see it
Ordering before approval is a conflict

exec: pm.test("Only approved requests can be ordered", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Only approved"));

item.name: Delivering before ordering is a conflict

exec: pm.test("Approved and recorded", () => { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("APPROVED"); pm.expect(r.decidedBy).to.eql("procurement"); });

item.name: Mark as ordered with a PO reference

exec: pm.test("Ordered with reference", () => { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("ORDERED"); pm.expect(r.orderReference).to.include("PO-"); });
pm.test("Has approval, order and delivery details", () => {
pm.test("Rejected with the reason", () => { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("REJECTED"); pm.expect(r.rejectionReason).to.include("two quotes"); });

item.name: A rejected request cannot be ordered
Submit a request far above the budget
